question: Owner 2026-10-28: enter at market only when the touch 5m bar closes back inside the 1.618 level, scored at that close; does the target need to change?
single_variable: Entry: resting limit at the level (earlier runs) -> market at the touch-bar close when it closed back inside; targets compared across the five Codex modes; stop, reclaim rule, fees and data unchanged.
score_column: stored (frozen model reading the touch bar, known at its close)

stops.P30: closed inside, -30 percent from the level, all targets
stops.P18: closed inside, -18 percent, near edge only (spike)
stops.B30: closed at or beyond the level (better price), -30 percent, all targets
stops.B18: closed at or beyond, -18 percent, near edge

fees: Codex config: market entry taker 0.05 percent, target maker 0.02 percent, stop / reclaim exits taker (OKX Lv1, read 2026-10-23)
control: Codex matched random submissions (3 per event, same symbol / week / side / volatility bucket) entered at market at their own close with the same percentage geometry, for events with score >= 0.5, v3 target mode, P30; plus all touches without a score filter
replays: frac N20 3x (v3-like), 10 slots 5x liq 19 (spike-like), all-in 3x monthly starts (allin3-like), seeds as the earlier studies
not_run: add legs (v3add20) need resting children, which market-entry parents do not support
in_sample: The score, thresholds and filters were chosen on the same history; the target comparison is in sample too
owner_followup: Owner asked why exclude touches that closed beyond the level; they run as B30 / B18 instead of being dropped.
